title: TwoHearts
description: You have two hearts on mob and on pvp. If you die to a player then you will lose your PvP heart. When you die to a mob then you will lose your mob heart. If you have lost both you will get banned
body: You have two hearts on mob and on pvp. If you die to a player then you will lose your PvP heart. When you die to a mob then you will lose your mob heart. If you have lost both you will get banned. The Bossbar is a timer that sets the Combat.
